item.title: Kirby Air Riders review - ChristCenteredGamer

Just about everything I wanted to see in a sequel is heremore players, more Machines, plenty of characters, and online support. The single-player content and vehicle customization are pleasant additions as well. However, it is a huge bummer that the matchmaking struggles to find players online. item.title: Vampire Survivors Remade In Hytale Shows Why So Many Players Are Hyped For The Minecraft Rival
item.description: Hypixel Studios, developer of the Minecraft-inspired survival game Hytale, has shown the sandbox games modding capabilities with a Vampire Survivors-like prototype that has fans excited ahead of the games Early Access launch later this month. In a social media post over the weekend, Hypixel co-founder Simon Collins-Laflamme shared a 40-second gameplay clip showcasing a character fending off voxel-based hordes of enemies in a top-down view arena.
